purpose: Name the remaining type-0x0F interaction and Level 12 final-scene actor-template records with complete consumers.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_0F_INTERACTION
templates.post_initialize: The 0x001B6FEE consumer sets actor facing byte +0x09 to 0xFF when allocation succeeds; the 0x001B6FE2 consumer performs the shared forward-slot spawn without that mutation.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_2F_LEVEL12_EVENT
templates.post_initialize: The event path initializes the allocated actor at position (0x02B1,0x022A).

conclusion: Both records are exact 20-byte templates selected by complete consumers. The type-0x0F record is bounded by two interaction-table entries and a facing mutation; the type-0x2F record is bounded by the Level 12 event condition and fixed final-scene position.
